objective: COA Gate 6A-R2. Repetir la auditoria de semantica de estados fiscales con enfoque metadata-first, evitando columnas no confirmadas. No DDL, no DML, no EXEC, no seeds y no Produccion. Confirmar estructura y vacio de dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidosEstatus; inventariar tablas/catalogos de estatus/fiscal/CFDI/factura; leer valores del catalogo existente dbo.Proveedor_EstatusSAT usando sus columnas confirmadas EstatusSATID y Descripcion; inspeccionar por metadata las columnas de dbo.Compras_DocumentosFiscales, dbo.Venta_Encabezado y dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos relacionadas con estatus/UUID/timbrado/cancelacion/SAT; y confirmar que dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos sigue sin datos. El objetivo es decidir despues si existe una semantica reutilizable o si Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidosEstatus necesita un catalogo propio.

queries.name: gate6a_r2_database_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: gate6a_r2_target_status_table
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidosEstatus') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: gate6a_r2_target_status_rows
queries.sql: SELECT EstatusDocumentoFiscalEmitidoID,Codigo,Nombre,Descripcion,EsFinal,Activo FROM dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidosEstatus ORDER BY EstatusDocumentoFiscalEmitidoID

queries.name: gate6a_r2_status_catalog_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,SUM(CASE WHEN p.index_id IN (0,1) THEN p.rows ELSE 0 END) AS approx_rows FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id LEFT JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id=t.object_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Estatus%' OR t.name LIKE '%Estado%' OR t.name LIKE '%Status%' OR t.name LIKE '%Fiscal%' OR t.name LIKE '%CFDI%' OR t.name LIKE '%Factura%' GROUP BY s.name,t.name ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: gate6a_r2_status_catalog_columns
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE (t.name LIKE '%Estatus%' OR t.name LIKE '%Estado%' OR t.name LIKE '%Status%' OR t.name LIKE '%Fiscal%' OR t.name LIKE '%CFDI%' OR t.name LIKE '%Factura%') AND (c.name LIKE '%Estatus%' OR c.name LIKE '%Estado%' OR c.name LIKE '%Status%' OR c.name LIKE '%Codigo%' OR c.name LIKE '%Clave%' OR c.name LIKE '%Nombre%' OR c.name LIKE '%Descripcion%' OR c.name LIKE '%Activo%' OR c.name LIKE '%Final%' OR c.name LIKE '%Cancel%' OR c.name LIKE '%Timbr%' OR c.name LIKE '%SAT%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: gate6a_r2_proveedor_estatus_sat_values
queries.sql: SELECT EstatusSATID,Descripcion FROM dbo.Proveedor_EstatusSAT ORDER BY EstatusSATID

queries.name: gate6a_r2_fiscal_document_metadata
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name IN ('Compras_DocumentosFiscales','Venta_Encabezado','Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos') AND (c.name LIKE '%Estatus%' OR c.name LIKE '%Estado%' OR c.name LIKE '%Factura%' OR c.name LIKE '%UUID%' OR c.name LIKE '%Cancel%' OR c.name LIKE '%Timbr%' OR c.name LIKE '%SAT%' OR c.name LIKE '%Fecha%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: gate6a_r2_new_fiscal_table_rows
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS documentos_emitidos_rows FROM dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos
